driver.code:
from machine import Pin

TM1638_CMD1 = 0x40
TM1638_CMD2 = 0xC0
TM1638_CMD3 = 0x80
TM1638_DSP_ON = 0x08
TM1638_READ = 0x02

_SEGMENTS = bytearray(b'\x3F\x06\x5B\x4F\x66\x6D\x7D\x07\x7F\x6F')


class TM1638:
    def __init__(self, stb, clk, dio, brightness=7):
        self.stb = stb
        self.clk = clk
        self.dio = dio
        self._brightness = brightness & 7
        self._on = TM1638_DSP_ON
        self.clk.init(Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.dio.init(Pin.OUT, value=0)
        self.stb.init(Pin.OUT, value=1)
        self.clear()
        self._write_dsp_ctrl()

    def _write_data_cmd(self):
        self._command(TM1638_CMD1)

    def _set_address(self, addr=0):
        self._byte(TM1638_CMD2 | addr)

    def _write_dsp_ctrl(self):
        self._command(TM1638_CMD3 | self._on | self._brightness)

    def _command(self, cmd):
        self.stb(0)
        self._byte(cmd)
        self.stb(1)

    def _byte(self, b):
        for i in range(8):
            self.clk(0)
            self.dio((b >> i) & 1)
            self.clk(1)

    def clear(self):
        self._write_data_cmd()
        self.stb(0)
        self._set_address(0)
        for i in range(16):
            self._byte(0x00)
        self.stb(1)

    def write(self, data, pos=0):
        self._write_data_cmd()
        self.stb(0)
        self._set_address(pos)
        for b in data:
            self._byte(b)
        self.stb(1)

    def led(self, pos, val):
        self.write([val], (pos << 1) + 1)

    def segments(self, segments, pos=0):
        for i in range(len(segments)):
            self.write([segments[i]], (pos + i) << 1)

    def number(self, num):
        self.segments([_SEGMENTS[int(c)] for c in '%08d' % num])

    def keys(self):
        keys = 0
        self.stb(0)
        self._byte(TM1638_CMD1 | TM1638_READ)
        for i in range(4):
            keys |= self._scan_keys() << i
        self.stb(1)
        return keys

    def _scan_keys(self):
        pressed = 0
        self.dio.init(Pin.IN, Pin.PULL_UP)
        for i in range(8):
            self.clk(0)
            if self.dio.value():
                pressed |= 1 << i
            self.clk(1)
        self.dio.init(Pin.OUT)
        return pressed

example.code:
from machine import Pin
import time
from tm1638 import TM1638
tm = TM1638(stb=Pin({STB}), clk=Pin({CLK}), dio=Pin({DIO}))
tm.number(12345678)
tm.led(2, 1)
last = -1
while True:
    k = tm.keys()
    if k != last:
        print('keys 0x%02x' % k)
        last = k
    time.sleep_ms(50)
